podcast.body: A special re-edition for Record Store Day. J Dilla is regarded as one of the great hip-hop geniuses of the last 20 years. Acquiring his material on vinyl can be very difficult in certain countries, making this release a valuable opportunity for fans to obtain a piece from this rap genius. "sale de Jay De La, Rothdraft, se redita especial para el Recorestor Day."
